setup:
# 1. Store our directories
MAIN_DIR="/Users/kartik/Documents/git-repo/nucleus-cloud-ops"
TARGET_DIR="$PWD"

echo "Copying environment files from $MAIN_DIR to $TARGET_DIR..."

# 2. Automatically find and copy all .env files, preserving the exact folder structure.
#    Using a while loop for robust path-handling and explicit path recreation.
cd "$MAIN_DIR" && find . -name ".env*" -type f \
  -not -path "*/node_modules/*" \
  -not -path "*/.git/*" \
  -not -path "*/.claude/*" \
  -not -path "*/.superset/*" \
  -not -path "*/.next/*" \
  -not -path "*/cdk.out/*" \
  -not -path "*/playwright-report/*" \
  -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d $'\0' env_file; do
    
    # Strip the leading './' from find output (e.g. "./web-ui/.env.local" -> "web-ui/.env.local")
    rel_path="${env_file#./}"
    dest_path="$TARGET_DIR/$rel_path"
    
    # Ensure the parent directory exists in the target worktree before copying
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest_path")"
    
    # Copy the file to replicate it in the new directory
    cp "$MAIN_DIR/$rel_path" "$dest_path"
    
    echo "✅ Replicated: $rel_path"
done

# 3. Return to the original workspace folder to continue with any other setup needed
cd "$TARGET_DIR"

echo "Environment files successfully replicated!"

# bun install && bun run dev
